bump: b(q)=exp(1-1/(1-q^2)) for |q|<1, else 0; C-infinity at support boundaries

pair_A.purpose: Directional/circulation perturbation in the task corridor vs a translated off-corridor region.
pair_A.native_delta: Use the SAME centred difference operators D_y and D_x on psi at h=0.25 m; du=D_y psi, dv=-D_x psi. Include the one-cell derivative halo. Translation is exactly 22 y cells. No mask multiplication of a velocity field that would introduce artificial divergence.
pair_A.privilege_boundary: Masks use only ROI/analytic flow orientation and fixed geometric offsets. They are interventions supplied by the experimenter, never a source-informed algorithm input. Both candidates receive the SAME mask. No true plume used to locate either mask.
pair_A.baseline_relevance_gate: Before perturbations, each source requires mean oracle Gaussian mass overlap with nominal on-box >=0.30 and nominal off-box <=0.01, q95 off <=0.05, for all four realizations. Also report derivative-halo overlap. If intended on/off contrast is not realized, PAIR_A_RELEVANCE_HOLD; never reposition the mask.

pair_B.purpose: Locally destroy task-height along-wind vertical shear vs an ordinary positive horizontal speed bias with the SAME smooth vertical support.
pair_B.x_y_extent: Entire native domain at z in (2,8); same perturbed support volume for both B arms.
pair_B.normalization: Before all plume outcomes, solve the float32 squared-error-energy equality on the declared z cell centres by 80 bisection steps over [0,0.1]; choose the endpoint with smaller error. No source/plume/RNG outcome enters this arithmetic.
pair_B.smoothness: Both are C-infinity analytical z profiles. B_speed is a smooth common speed bias with zero derivative at task height, so it preserves local shear; B_shear cancels the local derivative. Neither changes w.
pair_B.scope: Local shear destruction in a 6 m slab, not removal of all shear over the vertical guard.

RMSE.definition: sqrt(mean(||U_arm_f32-U0_f32||_2^2)) over fixed cell-centre audit voxels, after native float32 representation.
primary_audit_volumes: All Free cells inside the simulation outlet shell
All cell centres inside the fixed 3D analysis ROI
RMSE.relative_denominator: max(E_arm1,E_arm2), with neither equal to zero

physical_checks.obstacle_penetration: No internal obstacles; six true outlet faces are explicitly open. Field defined analytically throughout the whole box, including guard; no zero padding.
